children.text: Maitreyavyākaraṇaṃ samāptam // ye dharmā (etc.) // cīnadeśīvinirgataḥ bhikṣu puṇyakīrtir yad atra puṇyaṃ tad bhavatv ācāryopādhyāyamātāpitṛpūrvaṅgamaṃ krtvā sakalasattvarāśer anuttarajñānaphalāptaya iti // śrīmad gopāladevarājyasaṃvat 57 phālguna dine 9 Ghosalīgrāme likhati / oṃ hārītī mahāyakṣiṇī hara hara mama sarvapāpāni svāhā //
children.translated_text: The <s>Maitreyavyākaraṇa</s> (Prophecy of Maitreya) is complete. // The <s>dharmas</s> [that arise from causes, etc.] // The monk <s>Puṇyakīrti</s>, who came from China—whatever merit is here, may it be for the attainment of the fruit of unsurpassed knowledge, with teachers, preceptors, mother, and father at the fore, for the entire multitude of beings. // In the glorious reign of King <s>Gopāladeva</s>, [Saṃvat] 57, on the 9th day of <s>Phālguna</s>, written in the village of <s>Ghosalī</s>. Oṃ <s>Hārītī</s>, great <s>Yakṣiṇī</s>, take away, take away all my sins, <s>svāhā</s>! //

children.text:
iti maitreyavyākaraṇaṃ nāma mahāyānasūtraṃ samāptam |
ye dharmā hetuprabhavā hetu teṣāṃ tathāgato hy avadat |
teṣāṃ ca yo nirodha evaṃvādī mahāśramaṇaḥ ||
śubham astu ||
abdeglāvagnidvirade śita māghe guhānane |
pūṣāyāṃ pūṣṇadivase sarvvānanda samāpta kṛt ||
children.translated_text: Thus is completed the <s>Mahāyāna</s> <s>sūtra</s> named the <s>Maitreyavyākaraṇa</s> (Prophecy of Maitreya). | Those <s>dharmas</s> that arise from causes—the <s>Tathāgata</s> has declared their cause; and that which is their cessation—thus speaks the Great Ascetic. || May there be auspiciousness! || In the year [encoded numerically], in the cold month of <s>Māgha</s>, at the cave-mouth, on the day of <s>Puṣya</s>, on <s>Puṣya</s>'s day, <s>Sarvānanda</s> completed [this].
